pairs.difference: Sholay is Jai-Veeru, Gabbar and Ramgarh; Deewar is two brothers on opposite sides of the law ("Mere paas maa hai").
DDLJ is Raj and Simran in Europe and the mustard fields; Kuch Kuch Hota Hai is college friends Rahul, Anjali and Tina.
3 Idiots is "All is well", Rancho and Virus; Chhichhore is a hostel flashback told to a son in hospital.
Golmaal is the Ajay Devgn gang of four; Dhamaal is a race to buried treasure.
Friends is six friends at Central Perk; How I Met Your Mother is Ted telling his kids the story at MacLaren's.
Big Bang Theory is adult Sheldon and friends in Pasadena; Young Sheldon is Sheldon as a child in Texas.
Dangal is a true story about a father training his daughters; Sultan is a fictional comeback of a wrestler.
Andaz Apna Apna is Amar and Prem chasing an heiress; Hera Pheri is Raju, Shyam and Baburao with a ransom phone call.
Sacred Games is set in Mumbai, with Ganesh Gaitonde; Mirzapur is set in UP, with Kaleen Bhaiya and Guddu.
Kota Factory is about IIT coaching and Jeetu Bhaiya; Panchayat is about a village office secretary.
Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara is a road trip in Spain; Dil Chahta Hai is three friends in Goa and Sydney.
Game of Thrones is a TV series with dragons and politics; Lord of the Rings is a film trilogy about destroying a ring.
Harry Potter is a wizard school; in Narnia children walk through a wardrobe into a land with a lion.
Avengers is Marvel (Iron Man, Thor); Justice League is DC (Batman, Superman).
Titanic is a sinking ship and a love story; Avatar is blue aliens on Pandora.
Lagaan is villagers playing cricket against the British; Chak De India is the women's hockey team and its coach.
Breaking Bad is a chemistry teacher cooking meth; Money Heist is the Professor's crew in red jumpsuits robbing a mint.
Stranger Things is kids versus monsters in the 1980s; Squid Game is deadly children's games for money in Korea.
Baahubali is a kingdom epic ("Why did Kattappa kill Baahubali?"); KGF is Rocky in the gold mines.
Jab We Met is Geet and Aditya meeting on a train; Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani is Bunny and Naina on a Manali trek.
Finding Nemo is a lost fish in the ocean; Toy Story is toys that come alive (Woody and Buzz).
Taarak Mehta is a family sitcom in Gokuldham Society; CID is a crime show ("Daya, darwaza tod do").
KBC is a quiz show hosted by Amitabh; Bigg Boss is contestants locked in a house.
Jurassic Park is cloned dinosaurs on an island; King Kong is a giant ape in New York.
Mr. Bean is a silent man and his teddy; Home Alone is a kid left behind defending the house.
Fast and Furious is about cars and family; Mission Impossible is about spies and Tom Cruise stunts.
Roadies is tough tasks and auditions on bikes; MasterChef is a cooking competition.
Frozen is ice princesses ("Let It Go"); Shrek is a green ogre and a donkey.
The Kapil Sharma Show is comedy with celebrity guests; Indian Idol is a singing contest.
